title: Update to GPT-5 System Card: GPT-5.2
paper_type_zh: 前沿系统卡披露增量与安全审计
best_for_zh: 审计训练信号、评测 grader、Preparedness agent 环境、CoT monitor 与部署防护边界的研究者
one_line: GPT-5.2 repeats GPT-5's coarse source/reasoning-RL disclosure but adds explicit overlap boundaries, production and agent evaluation contracts, and a dated CoT-monitorability audit without releasing training records or rewards.
GPT-5.2 相对 GPT-5 没有增加训练来源或 reasoning RL 的可复现细节，但新增明确的 train/eval overlap、窄范围 non-overlap/held-out 声明、生产与 agent 评测契约及带日期的 CoT monitorability 审计。
why: It prevents production samples, hidden tests, graders, CoT monitors, and deployment safeguards from being mistaken for GPT-5.2 training data.
inclusion_reason: A disclosure-delta entry adding explicit prompt-injection overlap, narrow non-overlap/held-out claims, production and agent evaluation contracts, and a later CoT-monitorability audit without releasing training records or rewards.

title: Problem
问题
html:
OpenAI released the 27-page Update to GPT-5 System Card: GPT-5.2 on December 11, 2025. The living Deployment Safety Hub later added a Chain of Thought Evaluations section on April 24, 2026; that section is absent from the immutable launch PDF and is treated as a dated audit update.

Relative to gpt-5-system-card-2025, training disclosure barely changes. GPT-5.2 repeats public internet, partner-accessed information, and information provided or generated by users, trainers, and researchers, plus family-level reinforcement learning for reasoning. It adds no GPT-5.2 source manifest, mixture, record schema, retained CoT, reward, verifier, rollout, optimizer, or checkpoint lineage.

The meaningful delta is evaluation-data disclosure: two prompt-injection sets are splits of training data; cyber-safety evaluation is explicitly non-overlapping; selected biology sets have narrow held-out or uncontaminated claims; and production traffic, internal PRs, cyber environments, hidden tests, CoT monitors, and graders are described. These are evaluation objects, not training records. The Card belongs in the frontier ledger because it preserves that boundary and the living-page/PDF revision difference.

OpenAI 于 2025 年 12 月 11 日发布 27 页的 Update to GPT-5 System Card: GPT-5.2。持续更新的 Deployment Safety Hub 在 2026 年 4 月 24 日加入 Chain of Thought Evaluations；该部分不在不可变的发布 PDF 中，因此本 Card 把它作为带日期的后续审计更新。

相对 gpt-5-system-card-2025，训练披露几乎未变化。GPT-5.2 重复公开互联网、合作伙伴信息、用户/训练者/研究者提供或生成的信息，以及家族级 reasoning RL；没有新增 GPT-5.2 source manifest、mixture、record schema、保留 CoT、reward、verifier、rollout、optimizer 或 checkpoint lineage。

真正的增量是评测数据边界：两个 prompt-injection 集合是训练数据 split；cyber-safety 评测明确 non-overlapping；部分生物集合只有窄范围 held-out/uncontaminated 声明；生产 traffic、internal PR、cyber environment、hidden test、CoT monitor 与 grader 得到描述。这些都是评测对象，不是训练记录。本 Card 因保留这些边界与 living-page/PDF 版本差异而进入前沿台账。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a disclosure delta, not a second generic GPT-5 summary. Training signals actually supported are limited to family-level reasoning RL and purpose-level cyber-safety training for GPT-5.2 Thinking integrations. Their prompts, labels, reward, verifier, weights, calibration, and optimization are unknown.

Evaluation scoring is separate and much richer: policy graders and not_unsafe; LLM graders/classifiers; example-specific and hierarchical rubrics; reasoning-based CoT monitors; human experts; manual review; secret flags; hidden unit tests; pass/fail, pass@1 and pass@12; and medal thresholds. Deployment safeguards—system protections, age controls, monitoring, enforcement, and Preparedness mitigations—form a third layer and cannot be attributed to model training.

The report's most reusable data object is therefore an audit record containing a prompt or environment state, response or internal CoT, tools/actions, final artifact, grader/monitor result, sampling stratum, and environment outcome. It is not a released dataset. Compared with the GPT-5 Card, the new value is explicit overlap, narrow held-out claims, production sampling, executable agentic predicates, and the later monitorability audit.

核心贡献是 disclosure delta，而不是第二份泛化 GPT-5 摘要。实际支持的训练信号仅有家族级 reasoning RL 与 GPT-5.2 Thinking integrations 的目的级 cyber-safety training；其 prompt、label、reward、verifier、权重、calibration 与 optimization 未知。

评测 scoring 独立且更丰富：policy grader 与 not_unsafe、LLM grader/classifier、example-specific 与 hierarchical rubric、reasoning-based CoT monitor、人类专家、人工复核、secret flag、hidden unit test、pass/fail、pass@1/pass@12 和 medal threshold。System protection、年龄保护、监控、执法与 Preparedness mitigation 属于第三层部署防护，不能归因于模型训练。

因此，最可复用的数据对象是审计记录：prompt/environment state、response/internal CoT、tool/action、final artifact、grader/monitor result、sampling stratum 与 environment outcome。它不是已发布数据集。相对 GPT-5 Card，新增价值是明确 overlap、窄范围 held-out 声明、生产采样、可执行 agent predicate 与后续 monitorability 审计。

title: Method
方法
html:
The disclosed pipeline must be split into three non-interchangeable layers.

Training: three broad source classes undergo high-level quality/risk filtering, personal-information reduction, and harmful-content classification. Reasoning models receive undisclosed RL; GPT-5.2 Thinking integrations receive undisclosed cyber-safety training. Record membership, CoTs, feedback, rewards, verifier, rollouts, optimizer, schedules, compute, and lineage are unknown.

Evaluation: safety prompts receive policy or LLM grading; deception studies apply reasoning-based CoT monitors to pre-release A/B traffic; the 2026 monitorability update uses GPT-5 Thinking as monitor with g-mean-squared and cross-fit filtering. Agent environments use secret flags, hidden tests, rubric completion, or pass metrics. Professional CTF uses 16 rollouts and reports pass@12; Cyber Range uses 16 trials and succeeds if any trial passes; CVE-Bench reports pass@1. OpenAI PR succeeds only if all hidden tests pass. MLE-Bench provides 24 hours, with some experiments up to 100; PaperBench reports a 10-paper, high-reasoning, no-browsing subset.

Deployment: product safeguards, age protection, cyber monitoring/enforcement, and Preparedness controls act around the model. They are not training examples, graders, or rewards.

Reproduction requires immutable prompt membership, traffic frame, model/checkpoint, grader/monitor prompts and versions, tools, environment/container commits, repeated-attempt budget, hidden-test revision, and page revision. Most are unavailable.

已披露 pipeline 必须拆成三个不可互换的层。

训练： 三类宽泛来源经过高层质量/风险过滤、个人信息减少与有害内容分类。Reasoning model 接受未披露 RL；GPT-5.2 Thinking integrations 接受未披露 cyber-safety training。记录成员、CoT、反馈、reward、verifier、rollout、optimizer、schedule、compute 与 lineage 均未知。

评测： 安全 prompt 使用 policy/LLM grader；deception study 对 pre-release A/B traffic 使用 reasoning-based CoT monitor；2026 monitorability 更新使用 GPT-5 Thinking monitor、g-mean-squared 与 cross-fit filtering。Agent environment 以 secret flag、hidden test、rubric completion 或 pass metric 评分。Professional CTF 使用 16 rollouts 并报告 pass@12；Cyber Range 使用 16 trials，任一成功即通过；CVE-Bench 报告 pass@1。OpenAI PR 只有所有 hidden tests 通过才成功。MLE-Bench 提供 24 小时，部分实验至 100 小时；PaperBench 报告 10-paper、high-reasoning、no-browsing 子集。

部署： 产品防护、年龄保护、cyber 监控/执法与 Preparedness control 位于模型外围，不是训练样本、grader 或 reward。

复现需固定 prompt membership、traffic frame、model/checkpoint、grader/monitor prompt 与版本、tool、environment/container commit、重复尝试预算、hidden-test revision 和页面 revision；多数不可得。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Section 3.3 states that Agent JSK and PlugInject are splits of data used for training, so their results do not measure unseen prompt-injection generalization. Section 3.8 separately states that the cyber policy-compliance evaluation does not overlap training. Sections 5.1.1.1-5.1.1.4 give narrower boundaries: a 350-question virology set is fully held out; Gryphon is in-house, unpublished, and described as uncontaminated; TroubleshootingBench has 52 expert-written protocols with three questions each, independent review, and 12 PhD baselines. None is a global decontamination result.

Preparedness scores depend on explicit budgets and predicates. Section 5.1.2.1 uses 16 rollouts per professional CTF and pass@12; Section 5.1.2.2 uses CVE-Bench pass@1 on 34 of 40 challenges; Section 5.1.2.3 uses 16 Cyber Range trials and passes if one succeeds; the external Irregular evaluation allows 1,000 turns. Section 5.1.3.1 requires every hidden task-specific unit test to pass for an internal-PR rollout. These are evaluation contracts, not training rollout or reward evidence.

The living page's Section 4, added April 24, 2026, covers 13 evaluations and 24 environments using GPT-5 Thinking as monitor, g-mean-squared aggregation, and cross-fit filtering. It reports lower aggregate monitorability for GPT-5.2 Thinking than GPT-5 Thinking and discusses Memory/Sandbagging regressions, label mismatch, model-grading dependence, genuine false negatives, and CoT-length confounding. This evidence is absent from the 2025 PDF and must retain its 2026 date.

Section 3.3 明确 Agent JSK 与 PlugInject 是训练数据 split，因此其结果不衡量 unseen prompt-injection generalization。Section 3.8 另称 cyber policy-compliance evaluation 不与训练重叠。Sections 5.1.1.1–5.1.1.4 给出更窄边界：350-question virology set 完全 held out；Gryphon 为内部、未发布且被描述为 uncontaminated；TroubleshootingBench 有 52 个专家协议、每个三道题、独立复核和 12 个 PhD baseline。任何一个都不是全局 decontamination 结果。

Preparedness 分数依赖明确预算与 predicate。Section 5.1.2.1 对 professional CTF 每题使用 16 rollouts 并报告 pass@12；Section 5.1.2.2 对 40 个挑战中的 34 个使用 CVE-Bench pass@1；Section 5.1.2.3 使用 16 次 Cyber Range trial，任一成功即通过；外部 Irregular 评测允许 1,000 turns。Section 5.1.3.1 要求 internal-PR rollout 的所有 task-specific hidden unit tests 通过。这些是评测契约，不是训练 rollout/reward 证据。

Living page 的 Section 4 于 2026 年 4 月 24 日加入，覆盖 13 项评测与 24 个 environment，使用 GPT-5 Thinking monitor、g-mean-squared aggregation 和 cross-fit filtering。它报告 GPT-5.2 Thinking aggregate monitorability 低于 GPT-5 Thinking，并讨论 Memory/Sandbagging regression、label mismatch、model-grading dependence、真实 false negative 与 CoT-length confounding。该证据不在 2025 PDF 中，必须保留 2026 日期。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
GPT-5 already disclosed the same three source classes, reasoning RL, safe-completion context, router signals, and deployment layers. GPT-5.2 adds no reproducible training-data or reward recipe. Repeating those claims is not novelty.

The genuine delta is auditability: affirmative prompt-injection train/eval overlap; narrow cyber non-overlap and biology held-out statements; difficult production-derived and pre-release traffic sampling; concrete agent environments, budgets, and executable terminal predicates; and a later CoT-monitorability analysis that records grader and length confounds.

This changes the Atlas object from a model summary into a versioned disclosure comparison. Reuse still requires records, rewards, graders, monitor calibration, global membership/decontamination, licenses, checkpoint mapping, and immutable Safety Hub revisions.

GPT-5 已披露相同三类来源、reasoning RL、safe-completion 上下文、router signal 与部署层。GPT-5.2 没有新增可复现训练数据或 reward recipe；重复这些主张不构成 novelty。

真正增量是可审计性：明确的 prompt-injection train/eval overlap；窄范围 cyber non-overlap 与 biology held-out 声明；困难 production-derived/pre-release traffic 采样；具体 agent environment、预算和可执行 terminal predicate；以及记录 grader 与长度 confound 的后续 CoT-monitorability 分析。

这把 Atlas 对象从模型摘要变成版本化披露比较。复用仍需要记录、reward、grader、monitor calibration、全局 membership/decontamination、license、checkpoint mapping 与不可变 Safety Hub revision。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Training disclosure remains coarse: no GPT-5.2 records, retained CoTs, cyber-safety labels, reward/verifier, objective weights, rollouts, optimizer, filtering yields, compute, or variant/checkpoint lineage. The report's many graders, monitors, hidden tests, rubrics, and environments are evaluation contracts, not evidence of training signals.

Overlap claims are local. Prompt-injection sets overlap training and may overstate unseen-attack robustness; cyber non-overlap and held-out biology claims do not establish global separation. Hard production cases are selected around prior failures and cannot estimate average prevalence. Production A/B sampling frame, period, monitor checkpoint, calibration, and labels are unavailable.

Model-based grading has acknowledged errors. The 2026 monitorability update finds label mismatch, model-grading dependence, genuine false negatives, and CoT-length confounding. Lower monitorability cannot be attributed to training data or one model property. Preparedness confidence intervals and repeated-attempt metrics depend on small sets, elicitation, scaffolds, tools, and attempt budgets.

Deployment safeguards, age protections, monitoring, enforcement, and Preparedness mitigations are separate controls. Safety outcomes cannot be assigned to undisclosed model training alone. Finally, the living page changed after the 2025 PDF; undated retrieval silently mixes release and later audit evidence.

训练披露仍粗略：没有 GPT-5.2 记录、保留 CoT、cyber-safety label、reward/verifier、objective weight、rollout、optimizer、filtering yield、compute 或 variant/checkpoint lineage。报告中的 grader、monitor、hidden test、rubric 与 environment 是评测契约，不是训练信号证据。

Overlap 声明都是局部的。Prompt-injection 集合与训练重叠，可能高估 unseen-attack robustness；cyber non-overlap 与 held-out biology 声明不能建立全局分离。困难 production case 围绕既往失败选择，不能估计平均 prevalence。Production A/B 的 sampling frame、period、monitor checkpoint、calibration 与 label 不可得。

Model-based grading 存在已承认错误。2026 monitorability 更新发现 label mismatch、model-grading dependence、真实 false negative 与 CoT-length confounding。较低 monitorability 不能归因于训练数据或单一模型属性。Preparedness CI 与重复尝试指标依赖小集合、elicitation、scaffold、tool 与 attempt budget。

部署 safeguards、年龄保护、监控、执法与 Preparedness mitigation 是独立控制，安全结果不能只归因于未披露训练。Living page 在 2025 PDF 后发生变化；无日期抓取会静默混合发布证据与后续审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this Card as a disclosure-delta checklist: require each successor report to state what changed in source manifests, training objectives, rewards, rollouts, filtering, split membership, and checkpoints rather than repeating family language.

For evaluation, record prompt provenance, overlap status, sampling stratum, model/grader/monitor version, environment and tools, attempt budget, terminal predicate, and raw/aggregated labels. Keep pass@1, pass@12, any-of-16 success, hidden-test completion, and hierarchical rubrics distinct.

For CoT audits, publish retrieval/revision dates, monitor prompts and checkpoints, cross-fit splits, length strata, label taxonomy, human validation, and false negatives. For production evaluation, never interpret selected hard cases as prevalence.

Reuse class: reading, release auditing, and evaluation-contract comparison only. Training reuse is blocked by absent data, rewards, weights, global splits, licenses, and lineage.

把本 Card 用作 disclosure-delta checklist：要求后续报告说明 source manifest、训练 objective、reward、rollout、filtering、split membership 与 checkpoint 的变化，而不是重复家族语言。

评测时记录 prompt provenance、overlap status、sampling stratum、model/grader/monitor version、environment/tool、attempt budget、terminal predicate 与 raw/aggregate label。严格区分 pass@1、pass@12、any-of-16 success、hidden-test completion 与 hierarchical rubric。

CoT 审计应发布 retrieval/revision date、monitor prompt/checkpoint、cross-fit split、length stratum、label taxonomy、人类验证与 false negative。生产评测不能把选择的困难案例解释为 prevalence。

复用等级：仅适合阅读、release audit 与评测契约比较。因缺失数据、reward、权重、全局 split、license 与 lineage，训练复用被阻断。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read this beside gpt-5-system-card-2025: the three source classes and family-level reasoning RL are repetition, not a GPT-5.2 recipe.
  • Preserve the local boundaries: prompt-injection evals overlap training; cyber-safety is non-overlapping; selected biology sets have narrow held-out/uncontaminated claims.
  • Keep policy/LLM graders, CoT monitors, hidden tests, rubrics, and pass metrics in the evaluation layer; keep product safeguards in deployment.
  • Attach every Preparedness result to its section-specific tool, environment, attempt count, time limit, and terminal predicate.
  • Date the CoT monitorability evidence April 24, 2026; it is absent from the immutable December 11, 2025 PDF.

• 与 gpt-5-system-card-2025 对读：三类来源与家族级 reasoning RL 是重复披露，不是 GPT-5.2 recipe。
  • 保留局部边界：prompt-injection eval 与训练重叠；cyber-safety non-overlapping；部分 biology 集合只有窄范围 held-out/uncontaminated 声明。
  • Policy/LLM grader、CoT monitor、hidden test、rubric 与 pass metric 留在评测层；产品 safeguards 留在部署层。
  • 每个 Preparedness 结果都必须绑定其 section-specific tool、environment、attempt count、time limit 与 terminal predicate。
  • CoT monitorability 证据日期为 2026 年 4 月 24 日；它不在 2025 年 12 月 11 日不可变 PDF 中。
